mapper.sql: select p.id, p.partner_code as partnerCode, p.partner_name as partnerName, p.logo_file_id as logoFileId, lf.access_url as logoUrl, p.website_url as websiteUrl, p.public_description as publicDescription, p.partner_type as partnerType, p.cooperation_start_date as cooperationStartDate, p.cooperation_end_date as cooperationEndDate, p.partner_status as partnerStatus, p.sort_no as sortNo, p.remark, p.public_description as publicDescription, p.create_time as createTime, p.update_time as updateTime, ifnull(agg.total_support_amount, 0) as totalSupportAmount, ifnull(agg.support_count, 0) as supportCount, agg.latest_support_time as latestSupportTime from basket_partner p left join basket_file_asset lf on lf.id = p.logo_file_id and lf.is_delete = 0 left join ( select partner_id, sum(case when support_type = 'CASH' then support_amount else 0 end) as total_support_amount, count(1) as support_count, max(support_date) as latest_support_time from basket_partner_support_record where is_delete = 0 group by partner_id ) agg on agg.partner_id = p.id
mapper.select: select id, partner_code, partner_name, logo_file_id, website_url, public_description, partner_type, cooperation_start_date, cooperation_end_date, partner_status, sort_no, remark, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_partner where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

select id, partner_code, partner_name, logo_file_id, website_url, public_description, partner_type, cooperation_start_date, cooperation_end_date, partner_status, sort_no, remark, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_partner where is_delete = 0 and partner_name = #{partnerName} limit 1
select max(cast(substring(partner_code, 10) as unsigned)) from basket_partner where partner_code like 'CNPA-PT-%' and is_delete = 0

partner_name = #{partnerName}, logo_file_id = #{logoFileId}, website_url = #{websiteUrl}, public_description = #{publicDescription}, partner_type = #{partnerType}, cooperation_start_date = #{cooperationStartDate}, cooperation_end_date = #{cooperationEndDate}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, remark = #{remark}, partner_status = #{partnerStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
